I added `invoice_total(amounts)` in `invoices/total.py`, and `invoice_total([5, 10])` returns 1500. `python -m pytest -q` passes (4 tests).

It sums `payments.charge.charge` over each amount, so the total comes back in cents. `invoices/` is now a package with an `__init__.py`.

The tests are in `tests/test_invoices.py`. They cover `[5, 10]` giving 1500 and an empty list giving 0. I haven't committed anything.
